spec.name: sensor_arm
spec.description: Cantilevered sensor arm along x, fixed to the robot frame at x = 0, carrying a 20 N camera on a 20 x 20 mm plate centred on the x = 150 end face.

supports.note: Assumed: the arm attaches to the robot frame over its whole end face at x = 0, opposite the camera end, fully clamped.

loads.note: 2 kg camera weight (about 20 N), assumed to act downward in -z, on the 20 x 20 mm mounting plate centred on the x = 150 end face.

assumptions: The brief does not say where the arm meets the robot frame, so the x = 0 face is taken as the fixed attachment.
Gravity is taken as acting in -z.
